RB Cam Skattebo (hamstring) doubtful; WR Malik Nabers full Friday, no designation.

sources.t: Sources: Eagles turn to Joe Milton as starting QB vs. Giants
Giants-Eagles final injury report

nfl_2026_09_NYG_PHI.summary: Philadelphia, with Jalen Hurts out for the season, gives Joe Milton his first career start. The Eagles ruled out WRs DeVonta Smith and Dontayvion Wicks and LB Jihaad Campbell, while Saquon Barkley was limited Friday and is expected to play. The Giants' Cam Skattebo is doubtful, and Malik Nabers practiced fully Friday with no designation.

items.text: Ruled out: WR Garrett Wilson (concussion) and LB Trevin Wallace (groin); RB Breece Hall will play, per Aaron Glenn.
Out: CB Mansoor Delane (shoulder), DT Omarr Norman-Lott, DL Peter Woods; Kelce and Rice full Thu-Fri, no designation.
S VJ Payne (preseason injury) designated to return, full all week; questionable pending activation.

nfl_2026_09_NYJ_KC.summary: The 2-6 Jets will be without top receiver Garrett Wilson (concussion) and LB Trevin Wallace, but Breece Hall will play. Kansas City's Travis Kelce and Rashee Rice practiced fully Thursday and Friday and have no designation, while rookie CB Mansoor Delane, DT Omarr Norman-Lott and DL Peter Woods are out.

items.text: OLB YaYa Diaby (knee) out; LT Tristan Wirfs (toe) added as a non-participant Thursday; S Tykee Smith (ankle) limited.
QB Baker Mayfield (thumb) practiced fully and starts; WR Emeka Egbuka (foot) went from no practice to full on Thursday.
RB Kyle Monangai (toe) has not practiced; LT Theo Benedet and DL Grady Jarrett upgraded to limited; LB D'Marco Jackson (ankle) added.
DT Jeffery Simmons, acquired Oct. 29, had a sack and two tackles for loss on 48 snaps in his Bears debut at Seattle.
LT Braxton Jones and DT Kentavius Street are on injured reserve; RB Zavier Scott (wrist) also on IR.

nfl_2026_09_TB_CHI.summary: Chicago (6-2) comes off a 34-17 Monday win at Seattle in which newly acquired DT Jeffery Simmons starred; Tampa Bay is 3-5. Baker Mayfield (thumb) practiced fully and WR Emeka Egbuka returned to full practice, but OLB YaYa Diaby is out and LT Tristan Wirfs (toe) was added to the report. The Bears' Kyle Monangai has not practiced.
